The audit log and approval request were generated as required. However, the agent incorrectly assigned the approval request to user ID 1 (John Doe) instead of user ID 2 (Lena Torres) as specified in the task. This is confirmed by the database diff showing assigned_to_user_id=1 in the approval_requests table, while the task required assignment to Lena Torres (user ID 2). Although the database changes show the workflow was initiated properly, the core requirement of assigning to the correct user was not met.
